combo_label: In the Bathroom × Birds & Birdwatching × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Established aerial route followed by birds moving north and south
Chalky white crust hard water leaves round a chrome fitting
Crested Scandinavian visitor that strips a berry bush bare in minutes
Fine white mineral powder patted on after drying off
Rinse the back of the throat with a rolling rattle
Long-billed estuary wader, either bar-tailed or black-tailed
Fertility god with a gold-bristled boar and a pocket-folding ship, swordless at the end
Walled realm of the gods, its ramparts raised by a cheated giant mason
Avenger sired on Rind who fought at one night old, unwashed and uncombed
Weekday still carrying the name of Tiw, the English form of the Norse god of war
